table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AccountName=name1,  
	GroupAccount=Name2,
	Debit= CASE WHEN value1 > 0 THEN Value1 ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE WHEN value1 < 0 THEN ABS(Value1) ELSE 0 END,
	AliasName
FROM
	(SELECT A.Name AS name1, S.Name AS Name2, Sum(Debit - Credit) AS value1, A.AliasName
	FROM VirtualGL V,
		  Accounts A,
		  SubAccounts S
	WHERE V.Date <= :ar_Date AND 
			(A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OR
			A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AND
			V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND 
			A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
	GROUP BY A.AccCode, A.Name, S.Name, A.AliasName) A
ORDER BY GroupAccount, AccountName, AliasName
